pr_body:
Use a pre-allocated array to hold the intermediate transfers to avoid allocations. Replace some of RxJava code with Futures to avoid RxJava overheads.

This improves the perfromance of prefetchInputs on a large set of inputs from ~400ms to ~16ms.

Fixes #20555.

issue_context.title: `context.prefetchInputs` is slow on large set of inputs
issue_context.body:
### Description of the bug:


As shown in https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/8230#issuecomment-1852246547, `context.prefetchInputs` takes a couple of seconds on large set of inputs even if all of the inputs are already on the disk. For a no-op prefetch, it should be fast.

comments:
The repro used for the screenshot in https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/8230#issuecomment-1852246547 involves remote cache. The downloads may contribute to large portion of `context.prefetchInputs`.

When trying the repro locally with a clean disk cache, I only see ~400ms span of `context.prefetchInputs`.

A fix for this issue has been included in [Bazel 7.1.0 RC1](https://releases.bazel.build/7.1.0/rc1/index.html). Please test out the release candidate and report any issues as soon as possible. Thanks!
